title: Plain G1 ECDLP: (6,2) STNFS on a twisted C4 base field behind a run gate: expected work 2^116.551307763225

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, proof.md's algorithm (run gate, section 1, field-map.md, the GT core of proof.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns x from T=[x]P0 via z=e(T,Q0)=g^x, g=e(P0,Q0), with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT, at expected total classical work at most 1+(K/2^64) x 10 x (2^114.5864349900+2^66) < 2^116.551307763225 batched affine G1 additions (C=2,000; one core unit of 20,000 instructions = 10 units): an expectation over the challenge and the coins of the one attack on the one target, not a bound on every run. The attack first draws a 64-bit word u and stops as a failure (under one unit) unless u < K = 7201208159453235316, the least K with (K/2^64) x 0.999031 >= 0.39. Past the gate it succeeds with probability at least 0.999031, costs at most 2^125.230741679988 units (both logarithms metered at 2^121.9 core units, the ECM split at its row) and at most 2^114.5864349900 core units in expectation (the two logarithms at their expected work 2^109.277, H5, and the ECM split at its expected work; the other rows at bounds that hold in every run; the record walk and the matrix size at measured means + 2 SE, H3, H4). Nothing is amortized over other targets or runs. Analytic exploratory claim.
